en_usmani: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.
en_abdelhaleem: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.

en_wahiduddin: except for those who believe and do good deeds -- theirs shall be an unending reward!

en_itani: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end.

en_sarwar: except the righteously striving believers who will have a never ending reward.
en_shakir: Except those who believe and do good, so they shall have a reward never to be cut off.
